mutants.title: the fence ignores an aborted lease signal
mutants.reason: Defense in depth: every abort is also visible to the fence's token or expiry check (the local deadline never outlasts the row's expiry, and a refused renewal means the token moved).

mutants.title: the fence admits under an expired row that nobody took over
mutants.reason: Defense in depth: FOR KEY SHARE blocks a takeover while the transaction is open, and the token check refuses after one. test/persistence-sync-lease.test.ts still pins the refusal ("expired untaken").
